import subprocess,json
p=subprocess.run(['dpkg-query','-W'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=40)
items=sorted([a.split('\t',1) for a in p.stdout.splitlines() if '\t' in a and "a"<=a.split('	',1)[0].lower()<"f"])
print(json.dumps({'start':"a",'end':"f",'packages':items},separators=(',',':')))
